## Contract and outcomes

subscribe has separate lifecycle-state and scoped Patch overloads. Retain and call the returned unsubscribe function. Lifecycle state exposes phase, readiness, readOnly, localCommitted and error. A visible preview is not readiness; a change notification is not a persistence receipt.

## Errors and recovery

Handle state.error without deleting journal/checkpoint data. Unsubscribe before discarding a view and destroy it to release owned resources. Reentrant and late application work must respect the view lifetime.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

Only actual localCommitted receipts describe local persistence. Patch, selection, transport send and ready events do not establish remoteCommitted durability.
